fact: 1927年11月，英国政府宣布成立印度宪政改革调查团（西蒙委员会），由约翰·西蒙为首的七名英国下院议员组成，成员全部为英国人，无一名印度人。全印工会大会（AITUC）在1927年11月的会议上决议抵制该委员会。1928年2月3日调查团抵达孟买当日，约2万名工人上街抗议，各工业中心打出「西门滚出去」的黑旗。

sources.title: 百度百科，西门调查团
sources.quote: 该团于1927年11月成立,由以西门(John Simon)为首的七名英国下院议员组成,成员全部为英国人,代表英国保守党、自由党与工党。1928年至1929年,调查团两次赴印度进行调查,因其全英籍的构成被印度各界视为侮辱,遭遇举国一致的激烈反对与抵制。……1928年2月3日,西门调查团到达孟买时,人民用抗议性罢工迎接它,各大工业中心都打出了「西门滚出去」的黑旗

sources.title: CPI(ML) Liberation, CPI Leads Workers' Struggles（引 Sukomal Sen, Working Class of India）
sources.quote: In February, Bombay witnessed a massive demonstration on the day of Simon's arrival in Bombay. 20,000 workers came out in the streets in protest against the all-white Simon Commission.

fact: 1927年11月26至27日，全印工会大会（AITUC）第八次年会在坎普尔举行，左翼力量明显增强，会议讨论了抵制西蒙委员会、帝国主义对苏战争威胁、加入反帝大同盟等议题；贾布瓦拉当选行动委员会组织书记，丹吉（S. A. Dange）当选AITUC助理书记。此时印度共产党人已通过工农党（WPP）在国大党内部活动。

sources.title: CPI(ML) Liberation, CPI Leads Workers' Struggles（引 Sukomal Sen, Working Class of India, 1977, p.266）
sources.quote: the eighth congress of AITUC, held in Kanpur on 26-27 November, 1927 was also marked with the growing presence of an active left-wing group, mainly coming from the WPPs. They succeeded in getting discussed the issues like boycott of Simon Commission, the threat of war against USSR by the imperialists, the question of joining the League Against Imperialism etc. Communists also managed to get elected to some offices: Jhabvala became the organising secretary of the Council of Action and Dange became the assistant secretary of the AITUC.

sources.title: Self Study History, Nationalism and the Working Class Movements
sources.quote: Various Communist groups in different parts of India had by early 1927 organized themselves into the Workers' and Peasants' Parties (WPP), under the leadership of people like S.A. Dange, Muzaffar Ahmed, P.C. Joshi and Sohan Singh Josh. The WPPs, functioning as a left-wing within the Congress, rapidly gained in strength within the Congress organization.

fact: 据世界银行研究引用的工资序列，1927年孟买工业工人的平均日收入为255.21派士（1926年同值），孔坎农村的田间日工为108派士，城乡比为2.36倍。另据对1918—1928年孟买的研究，工人平均把收入的26%汇回乡下亲属。

fact: 1926年《印度工会法》在1927年适用：工会被承认为合法社团，规定登记与活动条件，并对工会的合法活动给予民事与刑事豁免，但限制工会的政治活动。罢工在1927年仍属合法，对公共事业罢工的限制要到1929年《贸易争议法》才确立；该法要求公共事业罢工须提前一个月由每名工人个别通知，并禁止纯政治性罢工与同情罢工。

sources.title: Self Study History, Nationalism and the Working Class Movements
sources.quote: Trade Union Act, 1926: Recognised trade unions as legal associations; laid down conditions for registration and regulation of trade union activities; Secured immunity, both civil and criminal, for trade unions from prosecution for legitimate activities, but put some restrictions on their political activities.

sources.title: Self Study History, Nationalism and the working class movements: Part II
sources.quote: The TDA, 1929: Made compulsory the appointment of Courts of Inquiry and Consultation Boards for settling industrial disputes; Made illegal the strikes in public utility services like posts, railways, water and electricity, unless each individual worker planning to go on strike gave an advance notice of one month to the administration; Forbade trade union activity of coercive or purely political nature and even sympathetic strikes.

fact: 1927年3月，印度立法机构在三个月的激烈争论后通过《货币法》修正案（Ratio Bill），该法于4月1日生效，法定确立1卢比＝1先令6便士的金平价，规定政府须按每托拉纯金21卢比3安那10派士的固定价格收购一切提交铸造的黄金，并取消索维林金币的法定货币地位。印度自此进入金块本位，直至1931年9月受大萧条冲击脱离金本位。此前因预期卢比升值，1925年与1926年上半年黄金异常大量流入印度。

sources.title: NBER, The Impact of the World Economic Depression on the International Gold Standard, 1929-1931
sources.quote: The amendments to the Currency Act passed in 1927 were embodied in a measure known as the Ratio Bill, which was forced through the Legislature only after a bitter three month struggle. ... The Currency Act of 1927 placed upon the government the obligation to purchase all gold presented to the mints in India at a fixed price of Rs. 21-3-10 per tola, corresponding to a sterling parity of 1 s.6 d. per rupee. ... The Currency Act of 1927 went into effect on April 1.

sources.title: Hansard, India (Rupee, Rate), 1931-02-11
sources.quote: The Government regard the rupee ratio question as having been settled in 1927 when the Indian Legislature passed the Currency Act by which the rupee was rated at 1s. 6d. gold.

fact: 1927年印度工业的长期融资渠道狭窄：以英国资本为主的汇兑银行与管区银行偏好向欧资管理企业提供短期贸易融资，不愿为印度人拥有的工业项目提供长期风险资本；欧资企业多通过管理代理行（managing agency）从英国或英资银行网络筹资，印度企业家缺乏同类网络；印度没有仿照德国、日本设立工业银行，塔塔工业银行是少见的私人尝试，最终并入一家商业银行。

sources.title: IAS Express, Indian Economy during British Rule（论殖民地金融结构）
sources.quote: The Presidency Banks and Exchange Banks preferred to lend to European-managed companies and for short-term trade finance. They were reluctant to provide long-term risk capital for Indian-owned industrial ventures. ... Indian entrepreneurs lacked access to such networks. ... The Tata Industrial Bank was a notable private effort, but it eventually had to merge with a commercial bank.

fact: 1928年4月至9月，孟买棉纺织工人举行为期六个月的总罢工，反对厂方的「合理化」措施与随之而来的减薪，罢工以厂方同意在官方调查委员会提出报告前恢复1927年工资水平而结束。罢工期间成立的红色旗帜工会（Girni Kamgar Union）会员从324人增至1928年底的54,000人，厂内至少42个工厂委员会在罢工中运作；而若希（N. M. Joshi）领导的温和工会当时只有9,800名会员。

sources.title: Bipan Chandra, India's Struggle for Independence, Chapter 17（NCERT Books 转载）
sources.quote: In Bombay, following the historic six-month-long general strike by the textile workers (April-September 1928), the Communist-led Gimi Kamgar Union (KU) acquired a pre-eminent position. Its membership rose from 324 to 54,000 by the end of 1928.

sources.title: CPI(ML) Liberation, CPI Leads Workers' Struggles
sources.quote: The first strike of 1928 was of six months duration. ... At least 42 mill committees were actively functioning during the strikes ... The strike ended only when the mill-owners agreed to restore the 1927 wages pending the report of an official enquiry committee.

fact: 1927年7月23日，私营的印度广播公司（Indian Broadcasting Company Ltd）依与印度政府的协议，在孟买开始实验性广播，这是印度有组织广播的起点；加尔各答电台于同年8月26日跟进。该公司因广告收入有限、经营困难，于1930年3月1日进入清算，广播设施由政府接管，1930年4月1日改设印度国家广播服务，1936年6月8日改名为全印广播电台。

sources.title: 印度新闻广播部（PIB），Radio broadcasting in India – a service to the community
sources.quote: This was followed by the setting up of a Broadcasting Service that began broadcasting on 23rd July 1927 on an experimental basis in Bombay and Calcutta, under an agreement between the then Government of India and a private company called the Indian Broadcasting Company Ltd. When this company went into liquidation in 1930, Indian State Broadcasting Service under the Department of "Controller of Broadcasts" was constituted. The Indian State Broadcasting Service was renamed as All India Radio in June, 1936.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Radio in India
sources.quote: According to an agreement on 23 July 1927, the private Indian Broadcasting Company Ltd (IBC) was authorized to operate two radio stations: the Bombay station which began on 23 July 1927, and the Calcutta station which followed on 26 August 1927. The company went into liquidation on 1 March 1930.
